name: woodwose
text: woodwose is a MacKillop cross-reference to the canonical wild man of the wood headword. MacKillop reads the form as a synonym pointer to the medieval European wild-man figure with Celtic attestation. The principal record of the wild-man tradition sits under wild man of the wood.

attributes.attribute: MacKillop synonym for the wild-man-of-the-wood figure
